title: Deploy Apricity to AWS Amplify at apricity.anth.us
description:
Take Apricity from local-only to a production deployment: Amplify Hosting for the web app, the Gen2 backend (AppSync, DynamoDB, Cognito with Google sign-in, S3 file storage), and the custom domain apricity.anth.us in Route 53. Nothing is deployed today (no amplify_outputs.json, amplify.yml, or deploy workflow).

Builds on apricitus-f2fe8394 (Cloud backend: sandbox, SDL snapshot, gating USER task apricitus-e28a12) and apricitus-25e216 (S3-backed Files + apricity sync). Do not duplicate those; complete them as prerequisites.

## Definition of done
- https://apricity.anth.us serves the web app over TLS from Amplify Hosting.
- Google sign-in works there, restricted to the allowed emails.
- The library (audio, slices, metadata) synced up from a local Mac is browsable and playable in the cloud app, hero demo included.
- Every deploy is repeatable from the repo (amplify.yml, backend definition, documented DNS records); no manual console steps left undocumented.
